name: Quote card
description: A cream document card that shows exact words (a law, an article, a definition, a quotation) in Georgia, with a small source label above and one phrase highlighted on its word, plus a one-line takeaway below the card.
use: Whenever the exact wording matters: an Article or law, a definition, a judgment's line, a report's finding, a thinker's words.
adapt: the words and source; which phrase is highlighted (highlight with words); drop the takeaway or the rule; longer text on two lines

name: Compare cards
description: A question heading, then two white cards side by side (a big year or label, a name, a small caption) that arrive one after the other, each with a solid verdict pill (red NOT / green YES), and a handwritten note with an arrow between them.
use: Two sides of something: before vs after, case vs case, myth vs fact, yes vs no.
adapt: 2 or 3 cards; card contents; pill colour and words; drop the pills, the heading or the note

name: Question card
description: A navy quick-check card: a small spaced label, the question arriving word by word, a timer ring with a question mark for a real pause, then a green answer pill.
use: A quick check with a pause, or any question the viewer should try to answer before the reveal.
adapt: question and answer; pause length (the ring's draw duration); drop the timer; several answer options instead of one

name: Timeline
description: A title, a horizontal line that draws in, then dated events that pop in one by one on their words (a big year above, a two-line label below); the key event is in saffron; an optional caption under it.
use: Dates in order: history, reforms, missions, stages of a process over time.
adapt: 2 to 6 events (space them evenly); which one is highlighted; labels on one or two lines; drop the title or caption

name: Big number
description: One large number that counts up, a small spaced label above it, a one-line context below with a key word underlined, and a small source line.
use: A single real, sourced number worth remembering (a count, a percentage, a year).
adapt: the number (prefix, suffix, decimals in count), label, context, source; drop the underline

name: Step list
description: A title, then numbered steps (a navy circle with the number, a line of text) that slide in one at a time on their words, and a small note under them.
use: A process, a procedure, or ordered points.
adapt: 2 to 5 steps; step text; drop the note; numbers or icons in the circles

name: Key term
description: A white card with a saffron edge: a small KEY TERM tag, the term in large type revealed from the left, its meaning in plain words on one or two lines, and a small exam note.
use: The first time an exam term appears (a glossary moment).
adapt: term, meaning, exam note; drop the note; a second line of meaning

name: Recap card
description: A white card with a navy border titled Remember, a short saffron rule, then 2 to 4 points that arrive one by one, each with a green tick.
use: A recap at the end of a part or of the lecture.
adapt: 2 to 4 points; title; ticks or numbers
